items.title: Hotel Customer Service Agent — WhatsApp AI Bot
items.subtitle: WhatsApp-native hotel support automation
items.description: Built an end-to-end Agentic AI workflow that handles room availability, pricing, booking FAQs, and escalation to human staff directly through WhatsApp.
highlights: Connected hotel policies, room types, and service information to an LLM through a grounded RAG pipeline.
Delivered accurate bilingual responses in Arabic and English for day-to-day customer inquiries.
Orchestrated WhatsApp messaging, retrieval, generation, and fallback logic in a single automated flow.

items.title: arabic_handwritten_character_project
items.subtitle: Arabic handwritten character recognition and retrieval
items.description: Designed a multi-stage deep learning pipeline for Arabic handwritten characters, benchmarking CNN-from-scratch against EfficientNet-B1 transfer learning before extending the system into embedding-based image retrieval.
highlights: Benchmarked 16,800 images across 28 classes and achieved a +59% performance lift over the scratch model.
Built cosine-similarity retrieval over learned embeddings with 98.33% Top-1 and 99.17% Top-5 accuracy.
Refined the embedding space with Triplet Loss, validated it with t-SNE, and wrapped everything in a single Colab + Gradio demo.

items.title: underwater-scene-understanding
items.subtitle: Robust underwater scene segmentation benchmark
items.description: Expanded the underwater scene understanding pipeline into a stronger comparative benchmark covering custom, pretrained, and hybrid segmentation architectures.
highlights: DeepLabV3+ with enhancement delivered the strongest overall mIoU across the benchmark.
SegFormer achieved the best Dice score, showing the strongest overlap quality among the tested models.
Enhancement consistently helped pretrained and hybrid models more than the scratch baseline, while multi-task variants did not beat the strongest single-task setups.

items.title: Company Document Chatbot — RAG-Powered AI
items.subtitle: Grounded multilingual document question answering
items.description: Built a RAG chatbot that answers employee questions strictly from uploaded company documents, grounding every answer in retrieved chunks with source-aware retrieval.
highlights: Supported PDF, DOCX, and TXT ingestion while reducing hallucinations through retrieval-first answering.
Implemented multilingual semantic search using embed-multilingual-v3.0 with configurable similarity thresholds.
Delivered both a Streamlit UI and a FastAPI REST API, fully containerized for one-command deployment.

items.title: YouHealth — AI Medical Chatbot
items.subtitle: Medical conversation structuring assistant
items.description: AI assistant converting patient conversations into structured medical reports. Nominated for the GAIA AI Accelerator.
highlights: Transforms patient interactions into organized medical summaries for faster follow-up.
Designed around healthcare-oriented conversational flows and structured output generation.

items.title: PhishWarden — Phishing Detection System
items.subtitle: ML phishing detection web application
items.description: ML-based system detecting phishing emails and URLs via NLP feature extraction. Full-stack Flask implementation.
highlights: Extracts linguistic and structural signals from suspicious emails and links.
Wraps the detection pipeline in a full-stack Flask application for practical use.

items.title: AI-Powered Crowd & Traffic Monitoring
items.subtitle: Smart city monitoring for safety analytics
items.description: Real-time smart city AI system combining object detection, action recognition, and zone-based heatmaps for safety analytics.
highlights: Combines multi-model perception for crowd behavior and traffic visibility.
Uses zone-based analytics and heatmaps to support real-time safety monitoring.
